d: Long, flowing rose-pink hair is styled with blunt bangs and a single side-braid, framing a youthful face with wide, olive-green eyes and a cheerful expression. The slender build is dressed in a white sailor-style top with a blue collar and a short, pleated navy-blue skirt accented with red trim. Signature details include grey armored plating on the shoulders and legs, a red ribbon in the hair, and a large red decorative knot at the chest.
